verdict.rationale: AMD's official ROCm PyTorch and JAX install pages explicitly list the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201). The Radeon support table covers PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX and ONNX on Linux and PyTorch on Windows for 9000-series GPUs, and AMD also publishes a compatibility-matrix selector and documented vLLM and llama.cpp support. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these frameworks run on this card (the community items are gaming reviews only), and broader Windows coverage beyond PyTorch.
